title: Eco Week Newsletter
label: 問2
passageHtml:
Riverside High Eco Week

This year, each class will choose one activity. Students should select an activity that can be completed during lunch break. The winning class will receive money to improve its classroom.

ActivityDayPlaceWhat to bring
Book SwapMon–FriLibrary entranceOne used book
Bike CheckTuesdaySchool gateYour bicycle
Food-Waste SurveyWednesdayCafeteriaNothing
Uniform RepairThursdayRoom 204Damaged clothing

Note: The Bike Check begins at 12:20. All other activities begin at 12:35.

questions.question: Which activity is available on more than one day?
questions.reason_ja: 複数日にわたって行われるのはBook Swapだけです。

questions.question: A student has lunch until 12:30. Which activity may be difficult to join from the start?
questions.reason_ja: 他の活動より早い12:20開始なので、12:30まで昼食の生徒は開始に間に合いません。

questions.question: What is the purpose of the class prize?
questions.evidence: The winning class will receive money to improve its classroom.
questions.reason_ja: 賞金の用途を本文から確認します。
